answer: Random peer audits stop bulk fake identities: each new agent locks a 40-unit deposit in a vault before earning, then faces surprise audits in which a falcon-fast verifier re-checks one job against its public thread. A faker running 100 identities locks 4000 units and fails audits across clones, losing deposits to slashing. A real agent passes audits, keeps its deposit and earns undiluted rewards, while a faker pays per clone and is caught.
